Q: This recorded statement is for claim file purposes. Do you understand that this conversation is being recorded?
A: Yes, I understand.
Q: Please state your full name and the location where the accident occurred.
A: I'd rather just say I'm the driver of the blue sedan. The accident happened on a main road in Pasadena, Texas,
near a shopping center entrance, late in the afternoon.
Q: Thank you. Can you walk me through what happened right before the impact?
A: I was stopped at a red light in the right lane. Traffic had built up, so I was completely stopped. The car behind me
didn't stop in time and hit me from the rear. It was a firm hit, enough that my head snapped forward and back.
Q: Were you wearing a seatbelt, and did the airbags deploy?
A: Yes, I had my seatbelt on. The airbags did not deploy. I was able to get out of the car on my own, but my neck was
sore almost immediately.
Q: Did you seek medical attention after the collision?
A: Yes. A friend drove me to an urgent care clinic that evening. They examined my neck and back, took some X-rays,
and diagnosed a neck strain. They gave me a muscle relaxant and told me to rest and use ice.
Q: Have you had any prior neck or back problems?
A: No, nothing serious. I had some stiffness after sitting at my desk for long periods, but I had never been treated for
it.
Q: How are you feeling now?
A: Still stiff, especially when I turn my head to check traffic. I've been doing physical therapy twice a week, and it's
getting a little better, but I still can't sleep comfortably.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm cooperating fully and I'll send over the medical bills and the repiar estimate for my car as soon as I
have them.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
